def count_lamps_right_of_tv():
    # Path to the image file
    image_path = "/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_56_image_1.jpg"
    
    # Create a detector instance
    detector = Object_Detector_Tool()

    # Load and detect objects in the image
    execution = detector.execute(image_path, labels=["lamps"], threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny", padding=20)

    # Get the bounding boxes of the detected lamps
    bounding_boxes = [bbox for label, bbox in execution['output_type'][1].items() if label == 'lamps'][0]['bbox']

    # Count the lamps to the right of the television
    right_lamps = sum(box[0][0] + box[0][2] - box[0][1] - box[0][3] for box in bounding_boxes if box[0][1] + box[0][3] > detector.image[0:1024,0:1024].shape[0] && box[0][2] > detector.image[0:1024,0:1024].shape[1])

    return right_lamps

final_result = count_lamps_right_of_tv()
print(f"{final_result} lamps are to the right of the television.")
